basic_info.description: Beautifully remodeled top floor 3-bedroom, 2-bath full-floor flat in a boutique 2-unit building. Located in trendy Bernal Heights, this light-filled home boasts modern finishes while maintaining its quintessential San Francisco charm, including bay windows, a decorative fireplace, and built-in cabinetry. The floor plan incorporates an open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area, providing direct access to an exclusive-use garden space. Modern updates include a stunning new kitchen with quartz countertops, a timeless subway tile backsplash, and a stainless steel appliance package with a gas range. The two remodeled bathrooms offer a tiled walk-in shower and the flexibility of a shower-over-tub layout. Additional upgrades include new floors and a laundry room. With three bedrooms, there's ample space for guests and a home office. Private storage and roof rights area included. Make 3535 Mission Street your new home today!
